description: Official feed captures of November 3, 2026, taken with the pipeline's user agent; Minnesota and Nebraska counts were all zero. Minnesota files are unmodified semicolon text from https://electionresults.sos.mn.gov/Select/MediaFiles/Index?ersElectionId=201; the Nebraska CSV is unmodified from https://electionresults.nebraska.gov/resultsCSV.aspx?map=CTY&text=All&type=SW. The tests add synthetic counts and candidates in memory (README.md).
